Resolves #19693

`Overflow.project()` no longer reports its own teardown as a live-owner defect. The catch decided "live" from `owner.mounted` plus the window's port, and destruction does not reset `mounted`. A tab header destroyed mid-projection during a Workstation pop-out therefore logged `project() threw against a live owner Symbol(Neo.isDestroyed)`, and the `workerErrors` fixture failed the journey.
- `src/tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs`: the live-owner test also requires that neither the plugin nor its owner is destroyed. Any other throw against a mounted, undestroyed owner in an undeparted window is still logged.
- `WorkstationReopenedPopupReturnNL.spec.mjs`: its allowlist line for this error (observation `a93f3f742aff4b33`) is removed.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms, red on `dev`, with mutation checks; hosted runs of both journeys on this head) → L3 required for the ten-shard `dev` receipts. Residual: those receipts. Residual-Owner: #19657.
